verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official CLI under its build-integrations docs for creating releases/builds and uploading files such as source maps to improve stacktraces, which is the core CI automation use case. A documented Data Access API, with authentication, pagination and rate-limiting docs, supports headless programmatic access, and a community user scripted exception dumps against it. missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline setup docs (e.g., named CI providers or non-interactive auth guidance), CLI coverage beyond build/upload tasks, independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.
